# Delta correctness verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES

PR #187 at `31c5113a4454a7cba01bddf410d3df6b694f0480`, answering `01a1bb44-a3f1-71b2-99f1-7a3d0af04800`. The previous `0b3640f` F001 block is closed, and its N001 mutation-proof gap now has retained receipts.

New plans are stamped `v:2`; missing or different versions are treated as legacy (`crates/daemon/src/background.rs:167-192`). Both batch and final replay rebuild body/subject from current job and batch rows instead of replaying their materialized text (`:869-884, 930-979, 1470-1491`). The replacement is recorded before admission (`:986-1001`).

Rebuilding preserves the Fyi/Held/Wake/Cold channel and Cold escalation target, notice file and plural mode. Only the job-derived subject is substituted into the old daemon-generated cold-facts prefix (`:200-226`). Content/render failure selects the short fenced notice, not recorded text; a persistence failure still stops before using the replacement. This closes the ordinary replay and newly authored Wake-to-Cold escalation paths identified in round 1.

The four legacy regressions exercise a pre-version stored Wake, a Cold final plan, the requested B9 downgrade with raw `Subject.what`, and a rebuild failure. Their double ticks assert one owner admission or held FYI, one prime escalation, preserved route/file, no owner wake on Cold, and persisted version/channel (`:3614-3902`). Existing already-admitted Wake behavior remains covered.

**Proof:** exact-head CI run `42482942573`, artifact `13618302496`, contains **2,258 passing Rust cases, zero failures/errors and zero reported skips**. All four legacy tests, fresh job/scope fencing and folder refusal executed. `pr-freeze` reported FINAL with matching heads and a clean detached worktree.

The retained author receipts include original RED reproductions, restored GREEN runs and M0-M7. M0 disabled rebuild and failed all four legacy cases; M1-M4 killed the tail/event/folder/scope guard removals; M5-M7 killed loss of cold facts, missing version stamp and missing fallback. Each mutation was asserted applied, restored and compared byte-identical, followed by restored GREEN. These runs used the source later committed as `558c5f77a70ad70e7660822edbf0eb71c64331c8`, not a mutation execution at `31c5113`; the guarded code and tests are unchanged across that rebase, verified by diff.

The requested range-diff maps reviewed `99f6d7b` to `71bf4e6` with only documentation context from the main merge; `31c5113` is the added repair. The fence helper is unchanged by the base move. No local reviewer builds/tests, product edits, credential reads, merge, push or review-HEAD movement.

**Scope note:** this is approval of #187's delta on the named stack, not clearance of #185 or its forthcoming round-4 base. A new head still needs an exact-head/base-delta verdict. Historical already-admitted payloads are not rewritten; the repair prevents legacy unadmitted plans and new downgrade notices from bypassing current rendering while preserving delivery idempotence.

Cost adds one version field and a one-time in-process reconstruction/store replacement for a legacy replay, not a new loop, poll or process launch. Independent security/performance verdicts remain separate.
